notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Baru.
Baru does not have summoning sickness.
You control a Wurm with power seven or greater.
description:
Activate Baru by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 4/4 Wurm creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wurm, adding {G}.
The Wurm dies, triggering Baru, untapping Baru.
Repeat.
